episodes.title: Duryodhan
episodes.angle: Bachpan se Bheem ne use maara, sabha me apmaan hua — kya Duryodhan asli villain tha, ya Mahabharat ka sabse bada anyay USKE saath hua? Ek yoddha jo doston (Karna) ke liye jaan de deta tha, par ek jalan ne use kha liya.

episodes.title: Shakuni
episodes.angle: Jis paase se poora Mahabharat bicha, wo Shakuni ke MARE HUE pita aur 99 bhaiyon ki haddiyon se bane the. Har ek chaal ek hi badle ke liye thi — poora Kuru vansh jad se mitana.

episodes.title: Dushasan
episodes.angle: Bhari sabha me Draupadi ke baal kheenche, cheer-haran kiya — usi pal Bheem ne kasam khayi: uska seena cheer ke garam khoon piyega. 18 saal baad ye bhayanak pratigya kaise poori hui?

episodes.title: Jayadrath
episodes.angle: Ek vardaan jisne use sirf EK din ke liye Pandavon se ajey bana diya — aur usi ek din 16 saal ka Abhimanyu chakravyuh me akela ghir ke maara gaya. Phir Jayadrath ka kata hua sar uske hi pita ki god me kaise gira?

episodes.title: Ashwatthama
episodes.angle: Raat ke andhere me sote hue poore Pandav-shivir ka katleaam kiya — Krishna ne use amar hone ka shraap de diya. 5000 saal se maathe pe risti ghaav aur akelapan liye, kya wo aaj bhi bhatak raha hai?

episodes.title: Jarasandha
episodes.angle: Do aadhe-aadhe bachchon ko jod ke paida hua samrat, jise koi astra-shastra maar nahi sakta tha. Bheem ne use cheer ke do tukde kiye, par wo phir se jud gaya — phir Krishna ne ek tinka utha ke jo ishaara kiya...

episodes.title: Kichaka
episodes.angle: Virat ke darbaar ka sabse taaqatwar senapati jisne chhupi Draupadi pe buri nazar daali. Us raat Bheem ne stree ka bhes badal ke usse aisa kuchla ki subah uska sharir pehchaanna namumkin ho gaya.

episodes.title: Karna vs Arjun
episodes.angle: Asli mahayoddha kaun? Karna: kavach-kundal, daanveer, par 3 shraap. Arjun: Gandiv, Pashupatastra, saarthi Krishna + dhwaj pe Hanuman. DONO ki taqat aur kamzori balanced do. Ant me: 'Karna ya Arjun? Comment me batao.' Respectful — sirf veerta ki tulna, bhakti pe sawal nahi.

episodes.title: Bhishma vs Drona
episodes.angle: Guru aur yoddha — kaun shreshth? Bhishma: ichha-mrityu, pratigya ke pakke. Drona: astra-vidya ke param guru par paksh-paati. Dono side. Ant: 'Bhishma ya Drona? Comment.'

episodes.title: Eklavya vs Arjun
episodes.angle: Sachcha dhanurdhar kaun? Eklavya: bina guru, angootha de ke bhi mahान — talent. Arjun: Drona ka priय, chidiya ki aankh — training. Talent vs training ki behes. Ant: comment bait.

episodes.title: Bhim vs Hanuman
episodes.angle: Dono Vayu-putra — zyada balwan kaun? Bhim: 10,000 haathiyon ka bal, Jarasandh ko cheera. Hanuman: parvat uthaya, samandar laangha. Bhai-bhai ki taqat. Ant: comment.

episodes.title: Ravan vs Duryodhan
episodes.angle: Bada villain kaun? Ravan: param-gyani, Shiv-bhakt, par ahankaar. Duryodhan: mitra-premi, veer, par jalan. Dono ke achhe-bure pehlu balanced. Ant: comment.

episodes.title: Karna vs Bhishma
episodes.angle: Kiska tyag aur pratigya badi? Karna: kavach-kundal tak daan kar diya. Bhishma: rajya aur vivah tyag, ajeevan brahmacharya. Dono ka balidan. Ant: comment.

episodes.title: Abhimanyu vs Ghatotkach
episodes.angle: Pandavon ka sabse bahaadur putra kaun? Abhimanyu: chakravyuh me akela lada. Ghatotkach: maya-yuddh, Karna ka Indra-astra khench liya. Dono ki veerता. Ant: comment.
